result.summary: Found 1 issue: a text overlap defect in the 'Popular right now' restaurant card where the delivery time and metadata line are rendered on top of each other, producing unreadable garbled text.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now', the delivery-time text and the metadata line ('€0 delivery • Ramen') overlap and render on top of each other, showing garbled text like '25-30rdelivery'. This makes the information unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the delivery-time range and the 'delivery • Ramen' metadata are placed on separate lines or properly spaced elements (e.g., correct the flex/grid row or remove an absolute-position/line-height conflict) so each string renders cleanly without overlapping.
